question: A double slit experiment (Interference) has a slit separation $d = 1 \text{ mm}$. A single slit experiment (Diffraction) uses a slit width $a = 0.1 \text{ mm}$. Compare the width of the central diffraction maximum with the width of one interference fringe for the same wavelength and screen distance.

options.A: Diffraction width is 10 times the interference width
options.B: Diffraction width is 20 times the interference width
options.C: Diffraction width is equal to the interference width
options.D: Diffraction width is 2 times the interference width
